chapter_en: Chapter 84: Relying on other people's strength

units.chapter_en: Chapter 84: Relying on other people's strength
units.title: 仗托人力总纲：以应爻为主、不遇绝空冲破为佳；佥解京差包完粮税、代出公庭、央邻里之谋为、浼亲朋之所作，事赖他成，前列人之事情皆附卦之应象；粮从产出差徭之重、山长水远人怯丁单，不无亲属之托须情故旧之央，诸般仗托皆看应爻

rule.yi: 要仗托别人出力，以应爻为主，以应爻不遇绝、空、冲、破为好。被派解送钱粮到京的差使，常有人包办完纳粮税；在县里当差，常有人替自己出公庭；或者央求邻里替自己谋划，或者请亲朋替自己做事，承受他们的庇佑，事情靠他们办成。前面列出的这些人的事情，都附在卦的应象上。粮从产业出，好像有差徭的重担；产业卖了、粮税还在，更多力役的征调；或者山长水远路途遥远，或者人胆小、丁口单薄，不能没有亲属的托付，必须央求旧交的情面；事情有万般祸患，要靠卦来一决；一切仗托别人的事，都看应爻。
rule.en: In relying on other people's strength, take the Other line as the chief and it is best if it meets no extinction, Void, clash or break. When one is assigned a commission to convey grain and money to the capital, there is often someone who contracts to complete the grain and taxes; when one is on duty in the county, there is often someone who goes to the public court in one's place; or one asks the neighbours to scheme on one's behalf, or begs relatives and friends to act in one's place, receiving their protection, so that the matter is accomplished through them. The affairs of the people listed above are all attached to the Other image of the hexagram. The grain comes out of the property and there seems to be the weight of service and corvée; if the property has gone but the grain tax remains, there are still more levies of labour; or the mountains are long and the waters far, a distant journey, or the man is timid and the adults of the household few and weak; one cannot but entrust the matter to relatives and must entreat old friends for their kindness; the matter has ten thousand troubles and the hexagram must settle it; in all kinds of relying on others, look at the Other line.

zh: 以应爻为主，不遇绝空冲破为佳。
yi: 以应爻为主要看的，不遇绝、空、冲、破为好。
en: Take the Other line as the chief to be looked at, and it is best if it meets no extinction, Void, clash or break.

zh: 佥解京差，每有包完粮税审，当县役常多代出公庭，或央邻里之谋为，或浼亲朋之所作身，叨彼佑，事赖他成。
前列人之事情，皆附卦之应象。
yi: 被派解送钱粮到京的差使，常有人包办完纳粮税；在县里当差，常有人替自己出公庭；或者央求邻里替自己谋划，或者请亲朋替自己做事，承受他们的庇佑，事情靠他们办成。
前面列出的这些人的事情，都附在卦的应象上。
en: When one is assigned a commission to convey grain and money to the capital, there is often someone who contracts to complete the grain and taxes; when one is on duty in the county, there is often someone who goes to the public court in one's place; or one asks the neighbours to scheme on one's behalf, or begs relatives and friends to act in one's place, receiving their protection, so that the matter is accomplished through them.
The affairs of the people listed above are all attached to the Other image of the hexagram.

zh: 粮从产出似有差徭之重，产去粮存尚多力役之征，或山长水远之迢遥，或人怯丁单之薄弱，不无亲属之托，须情故旧之央，事有万殃，卦须一决，诸般仗枉，皆看应爻。
yi: 粮从产业出，好像有差徭的重担；产业卖了、粮税还在，更多力役的征调；或者山长水远路途遥远，或者人胆小、丁口单薄，不能没有亲属的托付，必须央求旧交的情面；事情有万般祸患，要靠卦来一决；一切仗托别人的事，都看应爻。
en: The grain comes out of the property and there seems to be the weight of service and corvée; if the property has gone but the grain tax remains, there are still more levies of labour; or the mountains are long and the waters far, a distant journey, or the man is timid and the adults of the household few and weak; one cannot but entrust the matter to relatives and must entreat old friends for their kindness; the matter has ten thousand troubles and the hexagram must settle it; in all kinds of relying on others, look at the Other line.

note.yi: 「佥解京差」是被佥派去押解钱粮到京师的差使（解户之役，见前面户役一条）；「包完」是包办完成；「代出公庭」是替人到官府去应役。「粮从产出似有差徭之重，产去粮存尚多力役之征」讲的是田产已卖、粮税还留在名下，所以差徭反而更重。「仗枉」疑是「仗托」。「情故旧之央」的「情」是情面。「审」（「每有包完粮税审」）字义不顺，书里就是这个字，这里不译。这一章问的是靠别人出力办差役、办事，所以看应爻；和前面户役、帮户各章（EL.109 起）是同一类差役。
note.en: 'Qian jie jing chai' is the commission, to which one is assigned, of conveying money and grain to the capital (the service of a conveyor household, see the earlier entry on household service); 'baowan' is contracting to complete; 'dai chu gongting' is going to the authorities' court to serve in another's place. 'Grain comes out of the property and there seems to be the weight of service; if the property has gone but the grain tax remains, there are still more levies of labour' speaks of land that has been sold while the grain tax stays in the seller's name, so that the service is on the contrary heavier. 'Zhang wang' is presumably 'zhang tuo', relying on and entrusting. The 'qing' of 'qing gujiu zhi yang' is feeling and favour. The character 'shen' in 'mei you baowan liangshui shen' does not make sense and is exactly what the book has; it is not translated here. This chapter asks about relying on others' strength for service and for affairs, so the Other line is looked at; it is the same kind of service as the earlier chapters on household service and on sharing a household's burden (from EL.109).

units.chapter_en: Chapter 84: Relying on other people's strength
units.title: 仗托人力：应动应冲此客有更有变、应空应破其人无力无能，最嫌世受应伤更忌内遭外克；应值交重或逢冲动仗彼终须改变，应值旬空或临月破托人决不始终，若应克世或外伤内卦皆主其心不善不得误用

rule.yi: 应爻动、应爻被冲，这个被托的人有更改、有变化；应爻空、应爻破，这个人无力无能；最嫌世爻受应爻伤，更忌内卦被外卦克。应爻发动、或者逢冲而动，仗他办事终究要改变；应爻落旬空、或临月破，托人办事决不能有始有终；如果应克世，或者外卦伤内卦，都主他心地不善，不可误用。
rule.en: If the Other moves or is clashed, the man entrusted has changes and alterations; if the Other is Void or broken, the man has no strength or ability; what is most disliked is the Self being hurt by the Other, and still more the inner being controlled by the outer. If the Other moves or meets a clash that sets it moving, relying on him will in the end bring a change; if the Other falls on the ten-day Void or meets Month-break, the man entrusted will surely not see it through from start to finish; if the Other controls the Self, or the outer hurts the inner trigram, in every case his heart is not good and one must not employ him by mistake.

zh: 应动应冲，此客有更有变；
应空应破，其人无力无能。
最嫌世受应伤，更忌内遭外克。
yi: 应爻动、应爻被冲，这个被托的人有更改、有变化；
应爻空、应爻破，这个人无力无能。
最嫌世爻受应爻伤，更忌内卦被外卦克。
en: If the Other moves or is clashed, this person has changes and alterations;
if the Other is Void or broken, the person has no strength or ability.
what is most disliked is the Self being hurt by the Other, and still more the inner being controlled by the outer.

zh: 应值交重或逢冲动，仗彼终须改变。
应值旬空或临月破，托人决不始终。
若应克世，或外伤内卦，皆主其心不善，不得误用也。
yi: 应爻发动、或者逢冲而动，仗他办事终究要改变。
应爻落在旬空、或临月破，托人办事决不能有始有终。
如果应克世，或者外卦伤内卦，都主他心地不善，不可误用。
en: If the Other moves or meets a clash that sets it moving, relying on him will in the end bring a change.
If the Other falls on the ten-day Void or meets Month-break, the man entrusted will surely not see it through from start to finish.
If the Other controls the Self, or the outer hurts the inner trigram, in every case his heart is not good and one must not employ him by mistake.

note.yi: 「应值交重」的「交重」是动爻的记号，这里指应爻发动（见前）。「客」是被托的人。「不得误用」是不要错用了这个人。这一条与前面用人藏否（EL.132）「用来克世者，实怀欺主之心」取同一个关系：被托的人克世，就是心不善。
note.en: 'Jiaozhong' in 'ying zhi jiaozhong' is the mark of a moving line and here means the Other line moving (see earlier). 'Ke', the guest, is the man entrusted. 'Bu de wu yong' is not employing this man by mistake. This entry takes the same relation as 'if the Subject comes to control the Self, he truly harbours a mind to cheat his master' in the earlier chapter on employing a man (EL.132): a man entrusted who controls the Self has a heart that is not good.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 84: Relying on other people's strength
units.title: 仗托人力：财福生身而有益、见官克世以亏财，六冲则意乱无恒岂谐岂就、六合则心平有信能始能终；妻财子孙发动生助世爻终须有益，若见兄弟官鬼交重克冲世象岂不遭伤，六冲作事无成又无信实，六合所谋遂意更有始终

rule.yi: 财爻、福神生身，有益处；见官爻克世，就亏损钱财。六冲就心意混乱、没有恒心，哪里能和谐、哪里能成；六合就心平气和、有信用，能有始有终。妻财、子孙发动，生助世爻，终究有益；如果见兄弟、官鬼发动，冲克世象，怎么不受伤？六冲，作事不成，又没有信实；六合，所谋遂意，更有始有终。
rule.en: If Wealth and Output generate the Body, it is beneficial; if the star of office controls the Self, it costs wealth. With a six-clash the mind is confused and there is no constancy, so how could it be in harmony and how could it be accomplished; with a six-combine the heart is calm and there is good faith, so it can both begin and end. If Wealth and Output move and generate and aid the Self line, in the end it is beneficial; if Peer and Pressure are seen moving and clashing with or controlling the Self image, how could one not be hurt? With a six-clash, what is undertaken does not succeed and there is no good faith; with a six-combine, what is schemed turns out as one wishes and moreover there is a beginning and an end.

zh: 财福生身而有益，见官克世以亏财。
六冲则意乱无恒，岂谐岂就；
六合则心平有信，能始能终。
yi: 财爻、福神生身，有益处；见官爻克世，就亏损钱财。
六冲就心意混乱、没有恒心，哪里能和谐、哪里能成；
六合就心平气和、有信用，能有始有终。
en: If Wealth and Output generate the Body, it is beneficial; if the star of office controls the Self, it costs wealth.
with a six-clash the mind is confused and there is no constancy, so how could it be in harmony and how could it be accomplished;
with a six-combine the heart is calm and there is good faith, so it can both begin and end.

zh: 妻财子孙发动，生助世爻，终须有益，若见兄弟官鬼交重克冲世象，岂不遭伤？
六冲作事无成，又夫信实。
六合所谋遂意，更有始终。
yi: 妻财、子孙发动，生助世爻，终究有益；如果见兄弟、官鬼发动，冲克世象，怎么不受伤？
六冲，作事不成，又没有信实。
六合，所谋遂意，更有始有终。
en: If Wealth and Output move and generate and aid the Self line, in the end it is beneficial; if Peer and Pressure are seen moving and clashing with or controlling the Self image, how could one not be hurt?
With a six-clash, what is undertaken does not succeed and there is no good faith.
With a six-combine, what is schemed turns out as one wishes and moreover there is a beginning and an end.

note.yi: 「又夫信实」的「夫」疑是「无」（「又无信实」），译作「没有信实」。「福」是福神（子孙）。这是仗托人力一章的主体：六冲六合定能不能有始有终，财子生世则有益，兄鬼克世则受伤。与求馆章「凡值六冲之卦或无官鬼定无馆也」（EL.53）、谋望成事章「六冲之卦，事决不成」（EL.104）同取六冲不成的断法。
note.en: The 'fu' of 'you fu xinshi' is presumably 'wu', and 'you wu xinshi' is translated 'there is no good faith'. 'Fu' is the fortune spirit (Output). This is the main body of the chapter on relying on others: a six-clash or a six-combine settles whether there is a beginning and an end, Wealth and Output generating the Self is beneficial, and Peer and Pressure controlling the Self is injurious. It takes the same judgment that a six-clash does not succeed as 'with a six-clash hexagram there is surely no post' in the chapter on seeking a school post (EL.53) and 'with a six-clash hexagram the affair will surely not succeed' in the chapter on scheming (EL.104).

units.chapter_en: Chapter 84: Relying on other people's strength
units.title: 仗托人力结语：诸般之重托惟凭一卦之端详，百里倾心千金重托全凭一诺之寄皆系六爻之定

rule.yi: 各种重大的托付，只凭一卦的细细审详；百里之外倾心相托、千金的重托，全凭一句承诺的寄托，都系于六爻的断定。
rule.en: For every kind of weighty entrusting, one relies only on the careful examination of one hexagram; a heart given from a hundred li away and a thousand pieces of gold entrusted, depending wholly on one man's promise, all hang on the verdict of the six lines.

zh: 但若诸般之重托，惟凭一卦之端详。
yi: 但凡各种重大的托付，只凭一卦的细细审详。
en: For every kind of weighty entrusting, one relies only on the careful examination of one hexagram.

zh: 百里倾心千金重托，全凭一诺之寄，皆系六爻之定。
yi: 百里之外倾心相托、千金的重托，全凭一句承诺的寄托，都系于六爻的断定。
en: A heart given from a hundred li away and a thousand pieces of gold entrusted, depending wholly on one man's promise, all hang on the verdict of the six lines.

note.yi: 这是仗托人力一章的结语，后面没有解说。「一诺」是一句承诺；「百里」是百里之外。
note.en: This is the closing of the chapter on relying on others' strength, and the book gives no explanation after it. 'Yi nuo' is one promise; 'bai li' is a hundred li away.
